description: This file defines a RecyclerView Adapter for displaying a grid of device cards in an Android TV application. It manages device data, visual representation, focus styles, and user interactions such as toggling device states via clicks or key presses. The code includes device type management, accessibility features, and uses vector drawable icons for device representation.

classes.name: DeviceAdapter
classes.description: Adapter class for displaying device cards in a RecyclerView, supporting focus highlighting, toggling, and accessibility features.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Inflates the item view and creates a ViewHolder.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds device data to the ViewHolder, sets up focus styles, click and key listeners for toggling device states.

methods.name: bindIcon
methods.description: Assigns vector drawable icons based on device type.

methods.name: applyState
methods.description: Updates visual styles and text based on the device's ON/OFF state.

inner_classes.name: DeviceVH
inner_classes.description: ViewHolder class holding references to item view components.

inner_classes.name: Device
inner_classes.description: Data class representing a device with id, name, type, and power state.

inner_classes.name: DeviceType
inner_classes.description: Enum for different device categories: LIGHT, FAN, AC.
